### Start here

**Core resources**

- [Hyperliquid API docs](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api)
  - Start here for HyperCore REST and WebSocket endpoints, network URLs, and the maintained SDK list.
- [Official Python SDK and examples](https://github.com/hyperliquid-dex/hyperliquid-python-sdk)

### Data and actions

**API reference**

### Signing and precision

**Action safety**

- [Signing guide](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api/signing)
  - Match the two signing schemes, MessagePack field order, normalized numbers, and lowercase addresses exactly.
- [Nonces and API wallets](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api/nonces-and-api-wallets)
  - Design unique per-signer nonces and separate agent wallets across concurrent processes and subaccounts.
- [Asset IDs](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api/asset-ids)
  - Resolve different encodings for native perps, HIP-3 perps, spot pairs, tokens, and testnet assets.
- [Tick and lot size](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api/tick-and-lot-size)
  - Round prices and sizes to the protocol's significant-figure and asset-decimal rules before signing.
